payload.title: Raise the per-file test watchdog limit for test/rust-host/fgctl-init.test.mjs, or split that file,…
payload.description: Raise the per-file test watchdog limit for test/rust-host/fgctl-init.test.mjs, or split that file, so the full npm test run stops cutting it at 600s. Evidence 2026-10-14: in a full npm test run the 600-second per-file watchdog killed test/rust-host/fgctl-init.test.mjs. Run alone it passed 32, failed 0, skipped 1, but took 635s, because every test in it builds a Rust release. The test is not broken; it makes the full-suite result unreliable when the machine is loaded. The limit lives in scripts/run-tests.mjs: DEFAULT_FILE_TIMEOUT_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000 (line 157, overridable through env FGOS_TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT_MS, line 156), and the empty per-file map FILE_TIMEOUT_OVERRIDES_MS (line 161, read at line 180) exists for exactly this case; the supervisor is scripts/lib/test-file-watchdog.mjs. Options: add a test/rust-host/fgctl-init.test.mjs entry to FILE_TIMEOUT_OVERRIDES_MS, or split the file (or share one Rust release build across its tests) so each part stays well under 600s. Done when a full npm test run on a loaded machine no longer reports this file as killed by the watchdog.

payload.title: Make the confined-pane-accounts doctor check read the provider account inventory from the global…
payload.description: Make the confined-pane-accounts doctor check read the provider account inventory from the global config, so fgos doctor no longer skips it outside a configured project. In src/setup/registrations.mjs the confined-pane-accounts registration (line 4588) calls checkConfinedPaneAccounts(loadRunnerConfigFromDir(cwd)) (function at line 4342). The provider account inventory lives only in the global config (~/.fgos/config.json); a project config cannot declare provider accounts. So fgos doctor run from a directory without .fgos/config.json (for example ~) silently skips this check. The credential-copies-retained check had the same issue and was fixed by reading through readDoctorProviderInventory(), which calls loadGlobalConfig()?.runner; that fix is on branch fix/credential-phase-02-doctor-scan, not yet merged to main as of 2026-10-14. Suggested fix: reuse readDoctorProviderInventory() for confined-pane-accounts once that branch lands, with a test that runs the check from a cwd with no project config. Related low finding in the same function (line 4357): inventory[provider]?.accounts is a plain property read, so a provider named constructor resolves to Object.accounts; correct by accident today. Source: plans/261007-1700-provider-credential-rotation-safety/reports/code-review-261014-1000-doctor-stranded-copies-fix-round.md, Divergence 1 (line 87).
